mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(LOAN_AMOUNT), 0) / 100000000, 2) FROM TBL_BANK_LOAN WHERE LOAN_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'NORMAL', '1') AND (DELETE_FLAG = 0 OR DELETE_FLAG IS NULL)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) / 100000000, 2) FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE BILL_STATUS IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING', '1') AND (DELETE_FLAG = 0 OR DELETE_FLAG IS NULL)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(PLAN_AMOUNT), 0) / 100000000, 2) FROM TBL_INVESTMENT_PLAN WHERE PLAN_STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'DRAFT')
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) / 100000000, 2) FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE (DELETE_FLAG = 0 OR DELETE_FLAG IS NULL)
SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM TBL_FINANCING_PLAN WHERE (DELETE_FLAG = 0 OR DELETE_FLAG IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN PAYMENT_STATUS IN ('COMPLETED', 'PAID') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM TBL_REPAYMENT_PLAN WHERE (DELETE_FLAG = 0 OR DELETE_FLAG IS NULL)
